fit.method: backbone bond fit between rigid clusters with planar body clearance
fit.limitations: Local geometric fit, no simulation or base-pair energy. Clearance uses conservative helix-axis convex envelopes expanded by helix radius; it is not an atomistic clash test and does not repair internal body clashes. All geometry within each cluster is fixed.
